Basically, as an anti-money-laundering measure, overseas FX brokers often have the default rule:

"Withdraw to where you deposited."

That is, the amount you deposited from a bank must be withdrawn to the bank.

However, following this law amendment,

users have been receiving emails from XM, Axi and the like saying
"No matter how much you've deposited by bank until now, we'll reset that for now!"
(I think they came around June this year.)

In other words, overseas FX brokers may also, in response to this law amendment, make special arrangements without being bound by the default withdrawal rules.

So everyone, it's totally worth trying to negotiate with the broker you use!!
